recovered_spec.rule: outside frozen ROI: p_final_candidate = p_global; inside frozen ROI: p_final_candidate = resized p_refined

fusion_ablation_note: The Phase24 ablation-plan table does NOT define a fusion-matrix ablation ID. The only 'F1' identifier in the frozen matrix is the REFINER-family ablation 'refiner without p_global channel'. Any fusion ablation (e.g. learned fusion) is recorded in phase24_architecture_spec.fusion_rule as a FUTURE CONTROLLED ABLATION and has NO frozen ablation ID; it is therefore NOT_APPLICABLE under the current frozen matrix and may NOT be added opportunistically (see §22 performance-selection guard).

collision_resolution.in_success_failure_table: F1 = REFINER_FAILURE (a FAILURE criterion, not an ablation arm)
collision_resolution.in_ablation_plan_table: F1 = refiner without p_global channel (an ablation arm)
collision_resolution.disambiguation: Phase28 ablation arms use the ABLATION-PLAN namespace (A0-A8,R1-R3,F1). Success/failure criteria use the SEPARATE criteria namespace (F1-F5,S1-S3) and MUST NOT be conflated.
